desc:
🌿 Welcome to Garden Roots! 🌸

Create your dream garden from the ground up! ✨

🏡 Decorate your garden and make it truly your own!
🌱 Cut weeds
🌷 Grow beautiful plants and flowers
🦋 Discover and collect butterflies

Garden Roots is still in development, and there’s plenty more to come. We’re incredibly excited for you to see what the future holds! 💚🌼

⭐ Make sure to favourite the game
🔔 Press the bell icon so you don’t miss any updates
👍 And don’t forget to leave a like!

Thank you so much for supporting Garden Roots! 🌻🐝
We can’t wait to welcome you into the garden! 🌿✨
